posts.title: Interactive art, but it's a website.
posts.caption:
Hello guys! As I wrote in the topline, I put my painting on a website.

It is not just viewable; it is also interactable! Because I use Mediapipe to detect the user's eyes, mouse tracking, and real-time depth.

You can see the progress and the result in the links.
